title: 智能时代就业
text: 今天我们讨论机器对职场的影响。许多传统岗位面临巨大压力。基础性工作被自动化系统接管。这种现象之所以出现是因为算法效率极高。它能快速处理复杂数据。人类在速度上无法与之竞争。于是部分员工感到焦虑。他们担心失去生存空间。然而视角应当更宽广。技术进步往往伴随结构调整。某些旧职业消失的同时，新需求随之产生。比如数据标注员或模型训练师。这些岗位在十年前并不存在。人们之所以感到迷茫是因为知识更新速度太快。教育体系尚未完全跟上节奏。终身学习成为必然选择。我们必须培养独特能力。比如情感沟通与复杂决策。这些领域目前仍由人类主导。机器缺乏真正的共情心。它只能模拟逻辑而非感受。未来的核心竞争力在于协作。学会利用工具提升个人产出。而非将其视为敌人。社会需要重新定义价值。工作不再仅仅是重复劳动。它应当是创造价值的过程。适应变化的人将获得机遇。

questions.prompt: Why are algorithms replacing many basic jobs, according to the text?
options: Because algorithms have extremely high efficiency
Because human workers demand higher wages
Because governments mandate automation
Because companies want to reduce office space

questions.prompt: What examples does the text give of new jobs that did not exist ten years ago?
options: Data annotators and model trainers
Doctors and lawyers
Teachers and farmers
Journalists and photographers

questions.prompt: According to the text, why do people feel confused or lost (迷茫)?
options: Because knowledge updates too fast and education has not kept up
Because they lack access to computers
Because wages are too low
Because their bosses give unclear instructions

questions.prompt: What unique human abilities does the text say people must cultivate?
options: Emotional communication and complex decision-making
Physical strength and endurance
Memorization and calculation speed
Following instructions precisely

questions.prompt: What does the text say about machines and empathy?
options: Machines lack true empathy and can only simulate logic, not feelings
Machines have recently developed genuine empathy
Machines are better at empathy than humans
Empathy is irrelevant to job competition

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
